author: Unreal Engine
description:
QUICK Slo-Mo HACKS in UE5! Time Warp Tracks & Play Rate Curves: Learn how to quickly add global slow-motion effects using Time Warp tracks in the Sequencer, bypassing the need to manually re-time all animation keyframes. Compare the two main methods: the Play Rate Curve, which keys the speed of time (e.g., a value of 0.2 for 20% speed), and the Time Warp Curve, which directly controls the actual frame number being displayed. Understand that while this tool is fast, highly interpolated slow-motion might reveal interpolation flaws in the underlying animation that require minor fixes.
►Download the A-COM Animation Sample here: https://epic.gm/agora-animation-sample
► Check out Sir Wade's channel for more Animation Tutorials and UE5 workflows: https://www.youtube.com/@SirWade/
► Sir Wade's Courses: https://courses.sirwade.com
title: Slow Motion SECRETS! How to Time Warp Animation in Unreal Engine
